scope: Self-authored demonstration corpus, not a representative benchmark. Queries and relevance expectations frozen before model inference. File names/labels are not embedded for images.

items.label: retry-policy
items.text: When a card charge fails temporarily, wait for an increasing delay before trying again. Stop after three attempts. Use an idempotency key so a retry does not charge the customer twice.

items.label: incident-report
items.text: INC-042: The checkout API returned HTTP 503 errors. Queue depth increased after a worker deployment. We rolled back the worker and error rates returned to normal.

items.label: invoice-policy
items.text: Invoices are issued monthly for active seats. Administrators can download a PDF receipt from the billing page after payment succeeds.

items.label: queue-guide
items.text: The API enqueues a job and immediately returns a job ID. A worker consumes jobs asynchronously. The job result is written to the database.

items.label: request-timeout
items.text: The client waits up to ten seconds for a response. A timeout does not prove that the server did not finish the request. Query the request ID before repeating a payment.

items.label: release-guide
items.text: Each release uses a canary deployment, followed by a gradual rollout. Watch service health dashboards before increasing traffic.
